evidence.name: job-live
evidence.caption: Mid-drain, exactly as the browser's WebSocket received it: one delta per committed item, nobody polling.

evidence.name: job-feed
evidence.caption: The end of the same feed: the terminal delta arrives only after its row committed.

evidence.name: library-grid
evidence.caption: Eighteen of the library's files, spread across both datasets, served as 512-edge thumbnails from the content-keyed cache the detection job pre-filled.

evidence.name: recipe-shelves
evidence.caption: The recipe axis, counted by real joins: every list fetched from the app's own shelf routes at capture time, the album made and filled through the application a moment earlier.

evidence.name: copy-shelf
evidence.caption: GET /dupes after the phash and dupes jobs: each group is one picture shown by its best body, counted. An empty shelf is the honest answer when the library holds no perceptual copies -- and proof the similar renders did not falsely merge.

evidence.name: render-preview
evidence.caption: One of the app's own renders at lightbox size (1440 edge), decoded by the browser from the same cache -- with the recipe its own page serves for it.

evidence.name: people-index
evidence.caption: The people index: every avatar is the highest-confidence detected face of its cluster, cropped with context by the app. Names are nicknames for clusters, never identity claims.

evidence.name: person-page
evidence.caption: Everything the primary clustering attributes to Person 1, as their page serves it -- the cross-axis view: one person, wherever their pictures live.
